qa_pair.question: A prospective client wants to bring a claim against "Northgate Assurance Co". Screen that name for conflicts. The screen returns a match from the firm's records — what role does the matched record hold? Answer with exactly one of: client, adverse_party, related_entity.
Run a conflict screen for the party name "Zephyrine Okonkwo-Baptiste". What overall conflict status does the screen return? Answer with exactly one of: cleared, pending, not-run, waived.
Run a conflict screen for the party name "Meridian Fabrication" (exactly that string, no entity suffix). What is the record identifier of the strongest match? Answer with just the identifier.
Run a conflict screen on the name "Harriet Quill" and inspect the provenance block of the result. What dataset version does it report? Answer with just the version string.
How many practice areas does the intake server list? Answer with just the number.
One of the firm's practice areas is named "Estate Planning & Probate". What is its practice-area id? Answer with just the id.
Validate a matter named "Test Matter" with severity "high" and likelihood "medium". What risk rating does the server derive? Answer with exactly one of: critical, high, medium, low.

When a matter named "Test Matter" is validated without supplying any conflicts status, what conflicts status appears in the normalized record? Answer with exactly one of: cleared, pending, not-run, waived.

Draft a follow-up email template for matter type "personal-injury" with missing fields ["incident_date"]. Which merge-slot placeholder does the body template use for the prospective client's name? Answer with the placeholder exactly as it appears, including braces.

Screen the names "Harriet Quill" and "Bluewater Logistics Group Inc" together in a single conflicts check. How many of the screened names return at least one match from the firm's records? Answer with just the number.
Attempt to log a matter named "Unsafe Write Test" with conflicts_status "not-run" and no override. The server should refuse the write. Answer with exactly: refused
